ORDER

SAMPLE HIGH COURT - 2

1. The complainant states that the accused promised to deliver goods after taking a deposit of a sum, and the goods were never delivered to the complainant at all, despite repeated requests over many months.

SAMPLE HIGH COURT - 3

2. The complainant further states that the accused stopped answering calls after the deposit was paid and refused to return the money when asked on several occasions, and then denied any dealings.

SAMPLE HIGH COURT - 4

3. The accused denies the allegation and says the deposit was a loan that was repaid in full before the date of the complaint, which the complainant disputes strongly and says no repayment was ever made.

SAMPLE HIGH COURT - 5

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the dispute is civil in nature, and the learned counsel for the respondent submits that the facts disclose a cognisable offence on their face.
